assets.name: 狂热射击
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one existing square 2D game skill icon, 狂热射击 (Frenzied Fire).
Input image: edit target, the attached clean-blue-background flaming bullet icon.
Primary request: correct the bullet orientation. Redraw the central gold cartridge so its straight longitudinal axis is perfectly VERTICAL, pointing directly UP at 12 o'clock: pointed tip at the top center, round cartridge base at the bottom center. Keep both centered on the same vertical x coordinate. The bullet must not lean left or right and must not use a diagonal perspective. Keep it one recognisable golden machine-gun bullet, not a rocket or missile.
Preserve the original crisp cartoon outlines, chunky cel shading, gold/orange/white palette, and similar large foreground size. Reorient the red-orange flame aura and yellow flame streaks naturally around the upright bullet: fire trails mostly below and outwards, a strong energetic effect. Keep the clean slate-blue gradient background and thin broken circular cyan radar rings and short ticks. Do not rotate the square background or the radar ring.
Constraints: change only the orientation and accompanying flame arrangement. Preserve square opaque format and overall established visual style. No side bars, no vertical decorative edge stripes, no frames, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. Exactly one upright bullet. Deliver a clean finished game icon.
